title: Corbell and Coulthart find witnesses who place Lazar at S4

tellings.quote: Jeremy Corbell and Ross Coulthart found a bunch of people who have verified Bob's presence at S4, right?

plain: Michels says that the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell and the journalist Ross Coulthart found a number of people who confirmed that Bob Lazar was really at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert where Lazar says he worked on alien spacecraft in the late 1980s. Michels raises this himself, as a question, in an episode about the two days he spent with Lazar; if true, it would back up the most disputed part of Lazar's story, that he worked there at all.
